comparison_rules: Every primary metric declared by a scenario must appear in the trial record, with a measured value or an explicit missing/invalid/blocked/not_applicable status.
Candidates are comparable only when scenario, task/load, candidate-independent conditions, endpoint, protocol version, metric definition and unit match.
Water-phase totals must reconcile with the total-water metric within measured uncertainty.
Convert units only with an explicit documented conversion; never infer units from field names.
For ratios or percentages, publish numerator and denominator; a fraction is in [0,1].
Report paired differences and raw distributions; never substitute one composite score for the metric vector.
Hard safety gates are non-compensatory; an unknown gate is not a pass.
No improvement claim before matched physical trials; simulation and synthetic fixtures remain separate evidence classes.
Do not compare an absolute uncertainty number across metrics with different units or uncertainty definitions.
For commercial pre-rinse trials, spray force is a target-range variable rather than an objective to maximize; compare only under a frozen applicable test method, pressure and nozzle distance.

Metric unit must be one of the machine-readable unit_options for its registry entry, unless the entry explicitly declares protocol-defined; exact record units must still match between paired candidates.

A metric with qualifying_values is a non-compensatory outcome gate: physically eligible records must have a measured/derived categorical value in that exact list; gate declarations alone cannot compensate for a contradictory endpoint value.
